subject: assemblies-15-edit-a-part-the-open-assembly-uses
observed: pywin32 on a part open hidden as a reference of the open assembly: EditSketch worked (GetActiveSketch2 returned the sketch); AddDimension2 on the sketch circle raised com_error -2147417851 after about 12 s; Windows Application log event 1000 at the same second: SLDWORKS.exe, faulting module slduiu.dll, exception 0xc0000005; WER APPCRASH reports followed. ISketchManager.InsertSketch(True) left GetActiveSketch2 non-null; EditRebuild3 cleared it; the part then read unmodified with every feature error 0. About 20 min later SolidWorks showed the rollback-state dialog; the user could not select components and restarted (AppHangB1 on close).
